title: Jovial Malty Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: A malty and chewy Saudi Arabian dish featuring lamb kebabs with a unique blend of flavors, perfect for adventurous eaters. This low-carb-friendly recipe uses shortening and dashi extract for added depth.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together malt extract, shortening, dashi extract, garlic powder, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes per side, or until the lamb is cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
